title: Refactor Provider Abstractions
prompt: Generalize all hardcoded dependencies into composable providers: SourceControlProvider, ManagementProvider, SandboxProvider, LanguageProvider, EditorProvider. Each provider uses native CLI and provides configure method. Abstract GitHub issue/milestone code to ManagementProvider. Abstract agent hooks to EditorProvider.
summary: Refactored hardcoded provider dependencies into composable provider interfaces. Implemented SourceControlProvider, ManagementProvider, SandboxProvider, EditorProvider interfaces with GitHub, Devcontainer, and 7 editor implementations. Wired 54 lifecycle gh calls through ManagementProvider. Renamed GitHub-specific identifiers to management-generic. Added 10 provider tests.
